sources.snippet: Overview albert-base-v2 is a lightweight BERT-variant transformer model with 11 million parameters designed for masked language modeling and downstream NLP tasks. Built by albert, it uses parameter sharing across all 12 transformer layers to reduce memory footprint while maintaining the computational complexity of a standard 12-layer transformer. sources.snippet: ALBERT is a transformers model pretrained on a large corpus of English data in a self-supervised fashion. This means it was pretrained on the raw texts only, with no humans labelling them in any way (which is why it can use lots of publicly available data) with an automatic process to generate inputs and labels from those texts.
